stories.title: Build-A-Bear Recalls 36,000 Heartwarming Hugs Bears — Return to Store Now

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: RECALL: Build-A-Bear Heartwarming Hugs Bears (~36,000 units, Jan-Mar 2026). Zipper on heated bead pouch can detach — choking hazard. Stop use. Return to any Build-A-Bear store for a full refund or gift card. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: PIXLABBY Magnetic Fidget Sliders Recalled — Child Hospitalized After Magnet Ingestion

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: RECALL: PIXLABBY Magnetic Fidget Sliders (Amazon, 2025-2026, ~$10). Casing releases high-powered magnets — one child hospitalized after swallowing two. Stop use, photograph disposal, contact PIXLABBY for refund. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: High-powered magnets attract across intestinal walls and can cause perforation or worse. The PIXLABBY Fidget Slider recall is serious — one child already hospitalized. Check your home. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
